title: Make these 5 changes before charging your Pixel Watch overnight
summary: Optimize your Pixel Watch charging conditions by making these changes.
content: Charging your Pixel Watch overnight? Depending on your setup and Pixel Watch model, there are a few steps you can take to improve battery health and the overall charging experience. These changes include settings within your smartwatch, as well as other environmental factors to keep in mind.

title: SanDisk 1TB Extreme Portable SSD: 33% Off on Amazon

title: 4 useful kitchen gadgets you can make with an ESP32 this weekend (Nov 27 - 29)

content: You can put an ESP32 microcontroller to use all around your home, and that includes the kitchen. Most of us spend a lot of time in there cooking, eating, and hanging out, so why not make the space a little more functional with a weekend project or two.
